build_dataloader: build a pytorch dataloader from a dataset, batch sampler function, collate function, and num workers
create_dataloader_with_sampler: create a dataloader using a custom batch sampler function for distributed training across replicas
test_get_dataloader: test the get_dataloader function with a mock dataset and batch sampler function
review_get_dataloader: review the get_dataloader function and its distributed training rank and replica detection logic
refactor_get_dataloader: refactor the get_dataloader function to support additional dataloader configuration options
